grammar_changes: Share the finite Chinese TOST classifier family across context and task recognition: 双/两/两个/两项单侧检验.
Recognize interrogative age groups such as 哪些年龄的人 with adult activity or matching named-source context.
Recognize adjectival increment magnitude 小幅/大幅增加 while preserving separately requested progression-rate factors.

environment_attempt.cause: Base Python lacks pdfplumber; ruff is also absent. Project .venv supplies both.

boundaries: Magnitude, age and classifier words alone do not create physical-activity or statistical authority.
Age as a progression-rate modifier does not create an adult age-scope task.
Source identity and reviewed scientific permissions remain external to language recognition.
The three development failures and related finite grammar variants are implementation regressions, not independent evaluation.
